name: WeakFollowThroughBarRequiresPullback
longCondition: el_gt(close[1], open[1]) && el_ge(close[1] - open[1], bodyFraction * (high[1] - low[1])) && el_lt(std::fabs(close[0] - open[0]), weakBodyFraction * (high[0] - low[0]))
shortCondition: el_lt(close[1], open[1]) && el_ge(open[1] - close[1], bodyFraction * (high[1] - low[1])) && el_lt(std::fabs(close[0] - open[0]), weakBodyFraction * (high[0] - low[0]))
